findings.evidence: Sidecar `04-e-cart-totals-ssot.delta.json` records `cart_displayed_total: 23.7`, `backend_quote_total_ttc: 22.5`, `absolute_delta: 1.1999999999999993`, `verdict: P0_NUMERIC_INTEGRITY_DELTA`. Sidecar `04-e-cart-totals-ssot.quote.json` returns the backend pricing service result `data.subtotal: 22.5` and `data.total_ttc: 22.5` (no separate menu-formula line). State 01 DOM offset 8584-8587 shows the Salade Royale cart line rendered at €8,70 with note `Formule : Avec boisson (Coca-Cola 33cl)`; subtraction confirms the delta lives on this single line (frontend prices the formula at base 7.50€ + 1.20€ menu addon, backend prices it at the bare 7.50€ — the 1.20€ menu-boisson upgrade is DISPLAYED but NOT CHARGED). DECISION: backend under-charges, owner loses 1.20€ per Salade-with-Coca-formule order. Frontend display (23.70€) is the correct intended total per the menu-formula pricing model; the backend lacks the corresponding ratio logic.
findings.fix_hint: ROOT CAUSE: SSOT divergence between `resources/js/helpers/kioskPricing.js` lines 46-68 (`getKioskMenuAddonPrice` applies `pricing.drinkRatio = 0.4` to the full menu addon price → 0.4 × 3.00 = 1.20€) called from line 113 of the same file in `calculateKioskRunningTotal`, vs `app/Services/Pricing/PricingService.php` lines 193-216 (`addonTotal += (float) ($dbAddon->addonItem?->price ?? 0) * $addonQuantity`) which has NO ratio awareness — it can ONLY emit 0€ (addon absent from payload) or full addon-item price (~3.00€), never 1.20€. The frontend forwards `_boissonMeta.addonId` to `item_addons[]` (KioskWizardComponent.vue lines 1878-1889) but on the kiosk surface the menu-formula upgrade does not resolve to a normal addon row priced at 1.20€ in the DB — backend therefore charges 0. Fix paths (owner decision required): (A) Move the menu-formula ratio model into PricingService — read `kiosk_menu_pricing` config and apply the same `fullRatio/friesRatio/drinkRatio` multipliers when building `addonTotal` for kiosk surface; OR (B) materialise a real `item_addon` row with `addon_item.price = 1.20€` so the frontend ratio computation and the backend FK price match. Any path MUST ensure a triple-vert PHPUnit + Vitest + Playwright SSOT delta=0.00€ before merging. Backend is the source of truth (CLAUDE.md §3 rule 7) — frontend ratio must round-trip identically server-side. Until then, every Salade-with-Coca-formule order leaks 1.20€ of revenue and breaches NF525 fiscal SSOT (composition_snapshot will record an under-priced line).

findings.evidence: State 11 PNG shows simultaneously on the SAME viewport: card `Numéro de commande #A0063 — Montant à régler 22,50 €` and the bottom global cart bar `Mon panier €23,70 ›`. findings.evidence: Sidecar `09-e-payment-tpe-result-ok.network.json` captures `POST /api/frontend/order/309/payment-confirm → 401 Unauthorized` at ts 1778436693584. Console sink (`09-e-payment-tpe-result-ok.console.json`) records the matching `Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 401`. State 10 still shows confirmation #A0062 — so the receipt rendered for a separate order, but the CB happy-path payment-confirm itself FAILED auth. `app/Http/Controllers/Frontend/OrderController.php` lines 105-112 reject the call when `request->user('sanctum')` is null. Either the kiosk Sanctum token (`kiosk:order` ability, TTL 480 min per CLAUDE.md §9) was not carried on this specific axios call, or it was revoked between order create and payment-confirm. Not P0 because the order DID land downstream (#A0062 visible), but the 401 leaves order 309 in a hanging unconfirmed state.
findings.fix_hint: Investigate axios interceptor on the kiosk client — confirm `Authorization: Bearer <kiosk-token>` is attached to `/api/frontend/order/{id}/payment-confirm`. If the token is being silently dropped between order-create and payment-confirm (e.g. payment-confirm caller doesn't reuse the kiosk-cart store kioskToken), wire it explicitly. Add a Vitest unit on the payment-confirm caller asserting the Authorization header is present, and a Playwright network assertion that the response is 200, not 401, on the CB happy path.

findings.evidence: Sidecar `01-e-cart-multi-line.network.json` captures `POST /api/frontend/pricing/preview → 401 Unauthorized` at ts 1778436680947. Console log echoes the resource failure. The kiosk preview-pricing endpoint is being called from the cart screen unauthenticated despite the kiosk being logged in (Wave-E spec uses `loginAsKiosk`). DOM still renders the cart so the failure is silent — no `[role=alert]` or toast surfaces it to the user — but the preview is presumably falling back to the pre-quote frontend total (the 23.70€ that diverges from backend, see E-001). This is therefore a hidden contributor to the SSOT delta in E-001.
findings.fix_hint: Trace `/api/frontend/pricing/preview` route in `routes/api.php` and confirm the middleware stack matches the kiosk Sanctum ability (`kiosk:order`). Either the route is mis-scoped (requires a permission the kiosk token doesn't carry) or the axios call from kioskPricingPreview.js is missing the bearer token. Fix the call to include the kiosk Sanctum token; ensure the preview returns the same totals the quote endpoint will return so the cart screen displays an accurate pre-checkout total.

notes: P0 numeric_integrity DECISION: backend under-charges. The drinkRatio mechanism (0.4 × full menu addon price = 1.20€) is by-design fast-food formula pricing in `kioskPricing.js`. PricingService at line 214 has NO ratio awareness — it can only charge 0€ or full addonItem price, NOT 1.20€. Delta is exactly 0.4 × 3.00€ = 1.20€, confirming backend isn't applying the ratio. Owner loses 1.20€ per Salade-with-Coca-formule order; NF525 composition_snapshot is sealed with the under-priced line. V1 dine-in feature flag verified-correct (spec forced takeaway because cart default KIOSK = dine-in disabled per V1) — not flagged. Inactivity overlay popping during slow waits NOT investigated in this round (orchestrator's question deferred — would require timing-sensitive re-run). State 14 idle 'Je récupère ma commande' card is the takeaway button subtitle (`resources/js/languages/fr.json:1137` → `kiosk.order_type.takeaway_hint`), intentional UX copy NOT a stale recovery state — verified, not flagged. Console WS errors (`vendor.js` Pusher noise) per protocol allowlist — not flagged. Two P0s require a single coordinated fix: (1) move ratio-pricing into PricingService OR materialise real 1.20€ addon rows AND (2) add `kiosk.cash-instruction` + `kiosk.loyalty` to hiddenRoutes — without (2), even after (1) fixes the value, the cart-bar overlap UX defect remains.
